claims.claim: Concurrency defaults to 200 per worker process. At about 1 s per delivery, one process does roughly 200 deliveries/s, so you will likely need to scale worker processes horizontally.
claims.about: Node.js (BullMQ worker making outbound fetch calls)
claims.why: The figure comes from Little's law (200 in flight ÷ 1 s each). The benchmarks only measure Node as an HTTP server answering requests, not a queue worker making outbound HTTP calls, so they can't check the worker's rate or ceiling. The closest result, node-express at 14,188 req/s with 10 ms waits, is a different workload.
